description: Alias of create_program. Create a program for its first payment. An agent calls this at a person's request. Default commission 25%, percent range 10–50%; recurring_months: 0 only. No setup fee; you pay on approved sales. The agent never accepts the Clickwise merchant terms on its own: send terms_accepted with terms_version only after the person has read the merchant terms page and told you they accept them. Otherwise leave it out: the program is not set up until the person accepts them and you send terms_accepted with terms_version, here or later in POST /api/v1/onboarding/merchant/{application_id}/ with the access_secret (required action confirm_terms).

channel_restrictions.description: Promotion channels prohibited by the merchant for all publishers. An explicit empty list declares no additional prohibitions.

terms_accepted.description: True only when the person has read the Clickwise merchant terms and told the agent they accept them. The agent never accepts on its own. Send it with terms_version.
